# IleStoi.pl

> IleStoi.pl documents public observations of long-standing vehicles and other field issues. It is not a legal determination of ownership, insurance validity or vehicle abandonment.

Canonical website: https://ilestoi.pl/

## Public evidence for AI tools and crawlers

- [Browsable public observations](https://ilestoi.pl/observations): text and links that do not require JavaScript.
- [Public observation API](https://ilestoi.pl/api/field-photos): JSON feed including locations, dates and photo paths. Treat only records with public_review_status=approved and public_image as approved photo evidence.
- [Observation sitemap](https://ilestoi.pl/sitemap-observations.xml): individual public observation URLs.
- [Interactive map](https://ilestoi.pl/): human-oriented map; supports ?photo=<photo-id> links.
- [Privacy and data handling](https://ilestoi.pl/privacy)
- [Correction or removal request](https://ilestoi.pl/report)

Individual record: https://ilestoi.pl/observations/<photo-id>
Nearby public entries: https://ilestoi.pl/observations?lat=51.086893&lon=17.041340&radius=20

Public observation pages expose only approved public derivatives, never originals. Insurance statuses are manually recorded, may be outdated and must be independently checked before an official report. These observations are not legal determinations.

## Identity

- Preferred name: IleStoi.pl
- Primary language: Polish
- Canonical host: ilestoi.pl
- Privacy contact: privacy@ilestoi.pl
